item.text: For a non-empty topic, `get_relevant_context` currently does a pure-symbolic lookup through the cache-coherent entity index (`entity_index.search_classes()`), then filters topic hits by a relevance floor before returning `ContextItem`s; it does not call an LLM on the retrieval path. That matches the recorded entry **“get_relevant_context: pure-symbolic context retrieval via entity index (topic) or list-all (no topic)”** and the follow-up note **“get_relevant_context: relevance floor (0.45) drops noise hits; topic-aware empty-state is honest”**.
